source_ref: OSF v2zur (CC BY 4.0), cached waves read-only: W1/W2 .cache/c19prc_uk_mcbride_2021_shared/w12/C19PRC_UKW1W2_archive_final.sav (md5 cb2ffbf3348cb02736688d7533cc8caa), W3 .cache/c19prc_uk_mcbride_2021_comfort/w3/C19PRC_UK_W3_archive_final.sav (md5 c0c028d88079ed72825223b15ee1e332), W4 .cache/c19prc_uk_mcbride_2021_cmq/w4/C19PRC_UK_W4_archive_final.sav (md5 8fc1b14ac78c98cbe8ce14477f78a664): variable+value labels for W{1..4}_INFO_1-9; wording cross-checked against 'C19PRC_UKW1 survey questionnaire.pdf' Q74 p.36 (image-only, read visually), 'C19PRC_UKW2 survey questionnaire v2.pdf' Q74, 'C19PRC_UK_W3_Phase_2 questionnaire.pdf' Q474, 'C19PRC_UK_W4_Oversamples questionnaire.pdf' block INFO, and the measures information docx (W1/W2 2.2.7.1, W3 2.2.7.1, W4 supplementary 2.2.6.1)
note: Item codes INFO_1..INFO_9 are the .sav column names W{w}_INFO_N with the wave prefix stripped by data/c19prc_uk_mcbride_2021_build.py (crosswalk key infosource, waves 1-4; code IS the source column name after prefix strip, no rename dict, no positional step, no recode or reverse-coding). Variable labels are identical strings in all four waves: 'How much information about COVID-19 have you obtained from each of these sources? - <source>'; the shared stem went to instructions and the source to item_text, 9/9 identical to the questionnaire grid rows in every wave (W1 rows printed with (1)..(9) in INFO_N order). DEVIATION on option_text for resp=1: the anchor differs by wave. W1/W2 .sav value labels and questionnaires read 1='None'; W3/W4 .sav value labels and questionnaires read 1='Not at all'. 2='A little', 3='Some', 4='A lot' are identical across waves. Because the table pools all four waves under one item code, one string is needed; shipped 'None/Not at all', which is the study's own wording for this anchor in all three measures information documents ("scored on a 4-point Likert scale ranging from 1 'None/Not at all' to 4 'A lot'"), not text any respondent saw. resp=1 rows: W1 5795 + W2 4455 = 10250 read 'None'; W3 2504 + W4 6496 = 9000 read 'Not at all'. Cross-check (not required for data_labels): .sav per-wave x item x resp counts match the live table cell-for-cell, 144/144 (e.g. W1 INFO_1 699/524/478/324, W4 INFO_1 893/568/425/234); live table 57636 rows, 4949 ids, per-item n W1 2025, W2 1406, W3 853, W4 2120. W3 administered in Phase 2 only (per the W3 measures docx; Q474 absent from Phase 1 questionnaire); W4 grid found in the Oversamples questionnaire, not the Recontacts questionnaire text, yet the W4 .sav has 2120 responses per item and they match live. Study-specific ad hoc items, not a named published instrument; no rights-holder restriction beyond the deposit's CC BY 4.0.
public_note: The lowest response option was labelled 'None' in waves 1-2 and 'Not at all' in waves 3-4; option_text for resp=1 gives both as 'None/Not at all'.

(2020) measures information.docx' section 2.2.9.10; processing script data/c19prc_uk_mcbride_2021_build.py + data/c19prc_uk_mcbride_2021_crosswalk.py (key ius12)
note: Item codes are the .sav column names W1_/W2_IOU1..12 with the wave prefix stripped by data/c19prc_uk_mcbride_2021_build.py (crosswalk key ius12, stems IOU1-12, waves 1-2; number-preserving, no positional step, no recode or reverse-coding). Variable labels read '<preamble> - N. <item>' and are identical between W1_ and W2_ for all 12 items; the item part went to item_text with the leading 'N. ' numbering stripped (12/12 identical to the W1 and W2 questionnaire grid rows; curly apostrophes in items 6, 9, 10 kept as the source has them). instructions = questionnaire Q100 text, identical to the .sav label preamble apart from line breaks, which were collapsed to single spaces. option_text = .sav value labels '1.Not at all characteristic of me', '2', '3.Somewhat characteristic of me', '4', '5.Entirely characteristic of me' (identical on all 24 W1/W2 columns) with the leading 'N.' stripped; points 2 and 4 carry only their own number and are left blank, not padded. CAVEAT (midpoint label differs by wave): the W1 questionnaire grid prints '3. Somewhat characteristic of me' but the W2 questionnaire v2 grid prints a bare '3' (header row: '1. Not at all characteristic of me | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5. Entirely characteristic of me'); the .sav value label carries 'Somewhat characteristic of me' for W2 as well. Item codes are not wave-specific, so one option_text per resp is shipped and the W1/.sav label is used for resp 3; W2 respondents (16872 of 41172 live rows) saw that point unlabelled. ITEM ORDER: the study's IOU1..12 order is NOT Carleton, Norton & Asmundson (2007)'s IUS-12 numbering - it puts the 7 prospective items first (IOU1-7) and the 5 inhibitory items last (IOU8-12); the .sav's own W1_IOU_Prospective_Total and W1_IOU_Inhibitory_Total equal the raw sums of IOU1-7 and IOU8-12 for 2025/2025 respondents, which also shows the items are stored raw (no reverse keying in this scale). The measures docx attributes the 12-item form to Buhr & Dugas (2002); the 12 statements are the Carleton et al. (2007) short-form selection of the Buhr & Dugas English IUS. Cross-check (not required for data_labels): .sav per-wave per-item x resp counts match the live table cell-for-cell, 120/120 (e.g. W1 IOU1 267/492/797/341/128, W2 IOU12 356/335/435/193/87); live table 41172 rows, 2025 ids, 3431 rows per item, wave 1 24300 rows / wave 2 16872. RIGHTS: itemtext/instrument_rights_register.csv carries the parent IUS (27-item English, Buhr & Dugas 2002) as ship_with_note on the PhenX distributor statement 'This protocol is freely available; permission not required for use.' (https://www.phenxtoolkit.org/protocols/view/650701), a distributor statement not an originator grant; the IUS-12's wording is a subset of that English IUS. No restriction from Carleton et al. (2007) or the IUS originators could be located or quoted, so this ships on silence-is-permission per irw#1945, as the batch_151 IUS-12 precedent (quarter_life_crisis__iuc) did; no register row written (a round may not write ship rows). The item codes IOU1..12 carry no wording, so the item text is not otherwise present in the response table.
public_note: Item codes IOU1-IOU12 follow this study's own item order (prospective items first), not the standard IUS-12 numbering of Carleton et al.
